question:
The bar graph shows the number of patients visiting the hospital on different days of the week. Calculate the ratio of total number of patients on Monday and Wednesday to Thursday.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/056bbe7f9edc11c7aacb45142849bd01ce467060fcf56c600f91453897bed49d.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total number of patients on Monday and Wednesday = 146 + 138 = 284

Total number of patients on Thursday = 152

The ratio will be:

284: 152

71: 38

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
